name: Ras Frostwhisper in Leonid’s memory
shortDescription: Ras Frostwhisper in Leonid’s memory, represented in the Ras Frostwhisper research story.
body: An appearance-specific depiction of the same Ras Frostwhisper before his death, shown only in Leonid’s recalled scene. It is not a second character record. The image is an original interpretive illustration, not canonical game art or proof of exact costume, body, location, or simultaneous presence. This scene-specific appearance record refers to the same character as Ras Frostwhisper; it is not a separate person. See docs/research/ras-frostwhisper-production.md and docs/research/ras-frostwhisper-visual-assets.json.
